classification.source_level_rationale: created in the course of the activity it documents: This is an administrative record from the Nationalrat session of March 16, 2018, concerning a parliamentary interpellation on DNA searches in criminal investigations.
classification.resume: This is a parliamentary record of an interpellation submitted by National Councillor Lisa Mazzone on 16 March 2018 concerning the use of DNA for family searches in criminal investigations and whether the Federal Council intends to abandon this practice. It documents the debate held during the 2018 spring session of the National Council. The record is a transcript and video recording of the parliamentary proceedings.
